title: Polynomial-time computability of a finite-state transduction
statement: The function on Boolean words computed by the following finite-state transducer is polynomial-time computable. Its state records either no pending bit, a pending first bit of a pair, or a state in which it emits each input bit unchanged; initially it has no pending bit, and it emits each first bit and then, for a matching second bit, the bit indicating whether the two bits agree. If the pair disagrees, subsequent bits are emitted unchanged.
